finding: Slovak firms' upside inflation risk balance diverges further from euro area
bullets: A net 61.2% of Slovak firms (n=242) saw upside risks to five-year inflation, rising 2.3 pp from net 58.9% in wave 38, while the EA balance eased to net 54.0% (n=5,087) — suggesting growing divergence in inflation expectations.
The SK–EA gap widened to 7.2 pp as Slovak firms' upside risk balance rose and the euro area's declined by 1.3 pp — indicating increasing local inflation concerns.
Upside inflation risk remained the dominant view across all three economies, with net balances well above zero for Slovakia, the euro area, and Germany.
chart_subtitle: Net 61.2% of Slovak firms see upside inflation risk.
